name: Lulla (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of green and yellow at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Lulla (a white and green shield with a cross, a heart, a star and a bird, within a wreath of oak) above a yellow scroll inscribed LULLA.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Lulla arms with wreath and scroll
